# Wolf's Garage

> Wolf's Garage is a Portland, Oregon hot rod and custom car culture brand run by Wolf. It connects people with local car events, independent businesses, real builds, and hands-on skills that keep car culture alive. Get Back in the Garage.

The community is called The Pack. Wolf reviews every event and every business listing before it goes live.

## Find car events

- [Automotive events near you](https://www.wolfsgarage.com/events): car shows, cruise-ins, swap meets, drag nights and meets in all 50 states, searchable by ZIP code and distance. Refreshed nightly. Free to submit an event.
- Every event has its own page at https://www.wolfsgarage.com/events/ followed by the event name, with the date, venue, organizer, admission and directions. The full list of current event pages is in the [event sitemap](https://www.wolfsgarage.com/sitemap-events.xml).

## Find a shop

- [Hot Rodder Directory](https://www.wolfsgarage.com/directory): a map of locally owned businesses run by car people, flower shops to fabricators. Keep money local. No charge to list, ever.
- [Get listed in the Hot Rodder Directory](https://www.wolfsgarage.com/directory/get-listed.html)

## Shop

- [Wolf Wares](https://shop.wolfsgarage.com/collections/all): shirts, stickers and goods. Every dollar funds the next step.

## About

- [Wolf's Garage home](https://www.wolfsgarage.com/): events this weekend near Portland, the Pack Gallery of real builds, the Community Bulletin (parts wanted, parts for sale, public notices), and The Weekend Sheet newsletter.
- The long-term goal is a real shop space with youth and adult workshops, so the skills get passed down instead of lost.
- [Newsletter archive](https://us2.campaign-archive.com/home/?u=dc4fc447e326886743fcd078b&id=b0d82514d3)
- [Privacy policy](https://www.wolfsgarage.com/privacy)
